candidates.description: This vector represents frequency adverbs indicating how often an action occurs.
This feature vector represents conjunctive transition words and logical connectors used to indicate cause, effect, or relationship between clauses.
Interrogative and relative pronouns or question words introducing clauses.
This feature vector represents items of clothing, apparel, and wearable personal gear.
This vector activates for common present participle and base forms of high-frequency dynamic English verbs.
This feature vector represents spatial prepositions, positional prefixes, and related terms indicating relative location or direction.
This vector represents adverbs and adjectives related to convention, history, and typical or traditional practices.
This vector activates for terms and strategies related to human adversarial behavior, conflict, and customer or public relations.
This vector represents comparative and quantitative adjectives used to denote difference, quantity, or degree.
This vector represents numerical values, specifically small integers and number words.
